up: Retrieve a list of approved drugs that have an indication for COVID-19. Include the drug name and the indication term.
sql: SELECT DISTINCT md.pref_name, di.efo_term AS indication_term FROM drug_indication di JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON di.molregno = md.molregno WHERE md.max_phase = 4 AND (di.efo_term LIKE '%COVID-19%' OR di.mesh_heading LIKE '%COVID-19%')
